home.heroSubtitle: Your customers pick a free slot, pay with Pix or card, and the appointment confirms itself the second the payment lands. No back-and-forth, no manual approvals.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, city, or service

home.feature1Body: Availability is computed live from each provider's weekly template, minus blocks and bookings — never a double-booking.
home.feature2Body: A Pix QR or card checkout that confirms the booking automatically through a webhook the moment it's paid.
home.feature3Body: Providers see every booking with its payment status and can cancel or reschedule in a click.
home.step1Body: Choose a service and an open time on the provider's page.
home.step2Body: Pay with Pix or card on the secure checkout.
home.step3Body: The booking flips to confirmed the instant payment lands.
